category_edits.rationale: Test a pointwise coefficient of 0.25 across all four datasets. Prior reductions to 0.1 and 0.15 regressed; a modest increase may improve score calibration while retaining the existing pairwise ranking term and valid-position averaging. Preserve architecture, inference, optimizer, sampling and training limits.

response.change_summary: Increase only the pointwise-loss coefficient from 0.2 to 0.25. Retain one GRU4Rec model per category; predictor changes are unnecessary.
